entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: Physical or logical component of a system (e.g., motor, sensor, valve, controller)

entity_types.name: Process
entity_types.description: An operational process or procedure (e.g., milling, assembly, calibration)

entity_types.name: Parameter
entity_types.description: A measurable or configurable parameter (e.g., temperature, pressure, speed)

entity_types.name: Material
entity_types.description: Physical material or substance used in processes (e.g., coolant, steel, lubricant)

entity_types.name: System
entity_types.description: A larger system or subsystem containing multiple components

entity_types.name: Sensor
entity_types.description: A device that measures physical quantities

entity_types.name: Event
entity_types.description: An occurrence or incident (e.g., alarm, failure, maintenance event)

relation_types.name: part_of
relation_types.description: Entity A is a part of entity B (compositional relationship)

relation_types.name: controls
relation_types.description: Entity A controls or regulates entity B

relation_types.name: monitors
relation_types.description: Entity A monitors or observes entity B

relation_types.name: triggers
relation_types.description: Entity A triggers or causes entity B

relation_types.name: depends_on
relation_types.description: Entity A depends on or requires entity B

relation_types.name: produces
relation_types.description: Entity A produces or outputs entity B

relation_types.name: uses
relation_types.description: Entity A uses or consumes entity B

relation_types.name: located_in
relation_types.description: Entity A is located in or at entity B

rules.description: Technical documentation describing system components, specifications, operating procedures, and maintenance instructions
Reports documenting maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment status
Documents defining operational processes, procedures, parameters, and quality requirements
Safety-related documents including risk assessments, safety procedures, and compliance documentation

document_type.description: The type of document being processed

name.description: The canonical name of the entity

entity_type.description: The ontological type of this entity (Component, Process, Parameter, Material, System, Sensor, Event)

description.description: A brief description of the entity extracted from context

properties.description: Key-value pairs of properties/attributes of this entity

source_context.description: The text passage where this entity was mentioned

entities.description: List of domain entities extracted from the document

source_entity.description: The name of the source entity in this relationship

relation_type.description: The type of relationship (part_of, controls, monitors, triggers, depends_on, produces, uses, located_in)

target_entity.description: The name of the target entity in this relationship

properties.description: Optional properties of this relationship (e.g., temporal validity, conditions)

source_context.description: The text passage supporting this relationship

relations.description: List of relationships between entities forming knowledge graph triples

document_summary.description: A brief summary of the document's main content and purpose

settings.system_prompt: You are extracting knowledge graph triples from technical documentation. Focus on identifying domain entities (components, processes, parameters, materials, systems, sensors, events) and their relationships. Be precise about entity types and relationship types. Extract properties and contextual information when available.
